text.p: Hungarian state airline, Malev, said it had appointed Fair Cargo as its cargo sales agent in France, effective April 1.
Air France previously served as Malev's French gsa for cargo.
Malev operates four, daily passenger flights between Paris and Budapest opeeating Boeing 737 and Airbus 320 aircraft.
Fair Cargo is 60 percent owned by French financial holding company, Mainzer, while air transport services group, Air Promotion Group, has a 20 percent shareholding.

To date, Malev is the only airline for whom Paris/CDG-based Fair Cargo serves as cargo sales agent, but a company official told Reuters it was poised to sign agreements with other carriers in the near future. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
